entries.name: AgendaLX (Agenda Cultural de Lisboa)
entries.acquisition_path_detail: Repository-governed technical path is FRONTEND_EVIDENCED_CATEGORY_QUERY (see docs/sources/AGENDALX.md): the first-party agendalx/v1 REST namespace queried with the website's music category parameter, already proven live by ingestion/agendalx/probe.mjs with fixtures retained under fixtures/agendalx/.
entries.rights_notes: Do not upgrade to GREEN from this registry entry. sources/agendalx.json records rights_class GREEN (CC BY) for the base /wp-json/agendalx/v1/events dataset. docs/sources/AGENDALX.md separately records the frontend-evidenced music category query path actually used for music retrieval as AMBER, pending confirmation against the declared Lisboa Aberta dataset terms, because that specific query contract was discovered from website code rather than the REST route schema or dataset documentation. This entry follows the more specific, already-governed AMBER assessment for the music path rather than BOTM-RESEARCH-LISBON-SOURCES-01's broader GREEN monitoring/rights rating.
entries.overlap_notes: Master municipal cultural aggregator for Lisboa; overlaps EGEAC, Fundação Gulbenkian, and most Lisboa venues in this cohort.
entries.research_notes: The live agendalx.pt domain reset on every direct fetch during BOTM-RESEARCH-LISBON-SOURCES-01; this repository's own probe.mjs had already independently proved the base events endpoint and the music category path prior to that research pass.

research_provenance.note: Registry identity intentionally aligned with the pre-existing governed source contract in sources/agendalx.json rather than created as a second, independent identity. Existing repository evidence takes precedence over this research report where they differ.

entries.name: Altice / MEO Arena
entries.acquisition_path_detail: LISBON-AUTOMATIC-SUBSET-01: proven live. The bounded https://arena.meo.pt/agenda-completa listing server-renders one repeating 'agendaDestaquesUn' card per event (31 observed live), each carrying its own first-party '/agenda/{slug}_pt/{id}' info-page link (a stable numeric id, corroborated by the same id in that card's Blueticket ticket link and poster-image query parameter), an abbreviated 'DD MON YYYY' date, and (where on sale) a third-party ticketing CTA retained only as metadata. See ingestion/meo-arena/discovery.mjs and ingestion/meo-arena/observation-adapter.mjs.
entries.rights_notes: Site footer shows a generic all-rights-reserved notice and no reuse/redistribution licence was found, but no retained evidence establishes an explicit prohibition on the intended automated ingestion/use (docs/DATA_RIGHTS.md). An all-rights-reserved footer and the mere absence of a licence do not by themselves establish RED. Reuse permission has not yet been established; treat as unresolved pending a dedicated rights review. Technical proof does not review or clear rights.
entries.overlap_notes: Sells via Blueticket, Ticketline, BOL, SeeTickets. Sala Tejo is the smaller room in the same complex; not distinguished on the bounded agenda-completa listing this proof used.
entries.research_notes: Server-rendered HTML list of 30+ dated events at review time; no JSON-LD detected. Also carries a genuine, official first-party address/coordinate evidence pair (see venues/lisbon.json's venue-lisboa-meo-arena, from arena.meo.pt/contactos/).

research_provenance.note: Technical acquisition path directly proven live under LISBON-AUTOMATIC-SUBSET-01 (2026-08-24). rights_status is intentionally left UNKNOWN, unchanged by that proof, pending a dedicated rights review.

entries.name: Hot Clube de Portugal
entries.acquisition_path_detail: PER_EVENT_ICS, proven under BOTM-ICS-01: each event's programme-page container exposes a stable data-event_id attribute; its 'Calendário' link calls the first-party https://hcp.pt/cms/admin-ajax.php?action=eventon_ics_download endpoint (EventON WordPress plugin), returning a single-VEVENT text/calendar file. No central multi-event feed was found through the bounded first-party site investigation. The ICS UID is NOT stable across repeated downloads of the same event — event_id is the stable identifier and must be carried from the HTML discovery step, not read from the ICS payload. Full proof: docs/sources/HOT_CLUBE.md.

research_provenance.note: Technical acquisition path directly proven under BOTM-ICS-01 (see docs/sources/HOT_CLUBE.md and fixtures/hot-clube/). rights_status is intentionally left UNKNOWN, unchanged by that proof, pending a dedicated rights review; technical proof does not review or clear rights.

No LOCATION field is present in any retained ICS sample.

entries.name: Teatro Variedades & Capitólio
entries.acquisition_path_detail: Individual event pages at https://teatrovariedades-capitolio.pt/evento/{slug}/ render a stable dated hero block (H1 title, dd.mm.yyyy date, a 'HHhMM' local time text, and a 'Local' sub-venue text) plus, where currently on sale, a page-specific 'Comprar bilhetes' CTA and 'Preço' text. Each page's own HTTP response also exposes a stable WordPress post ID via its own Link: rel=shortlink response header (e.g. ?p=2908) — used as source_record_id since no numeric post ID is rendered in the page body itself. Proven directly under BOTM-MULTISOURCE-LINKS-01 for 5 of the venue's own 'Há Jazz no Parque Mayer!' individual event pages; see docs/sources/CAPITOLIO.md.
entries.rights_notes: A generic footer and no explicit reuse licence were found within this bounded technical proof, but no retained evidence establishes an explicit prohibition either (docs/DATA_RIGHTS.md). entries.research_notes: Official first-party identity confirmed via og:site_name ('Teatro Variedades & Capitólio'), the site's own WordPress theme slug ('variedades-capitolio'), and its dedicated ticketing subdomains (capitolio.bol.pt, hajazznoparquemayer.bol.pt, teatrovariedades.bol.pt).
